summary: Re-checked from scratch and everything holds up: the Hanoi rat hunt, both quotations, the cobra, Campbell and cash-for-ash details, and every link. No changes needed.
notes: Stormont: McGuinness resigned on 9 January 2017; the Executive formally fell on 16 January when Sinn Féin declined to nominate a replacement. 'Bringing down' is fair as cause and effect.
Strathern's 1997 wording adapts an earlier phrasing by Keith Hoskin (1996); it is still the version most people quote.
Campbell's law was first set out in a 1976 working paper, published in 1979 as the story says.
The Vann and Clarke book came out in 2018; some catalogues date the paperback 2019.
The DOI link for Vann's 2003 article opens Project MUSE, which may show a brief 'are you human' check before the page.
